title: Keyblade Registry - Kingdom Hearts 0: Door to Darkness
note: The Twilight Keyblade is Zero's signature blade: the fusion of Oblivion and Oathkeeper, forged when light and dark chose the same wielder. It is an all-rounder - one of the best blades in the game - outclassed only in narrow niches by the keyblades of the other wielders, each tuned for a different character build.

keyblades.name: Twilight Keyblade
keyblades.source: Oblivion + Oathkeeper, fully mixed into one blade
keyblades.unlock_desc: Roxas's red feather in Twilight Town: light and dark refuse to part, and two halves of the same Keyblade become one.
keyblades.desc: One blade, two heart-halves. Perfectly balanced strength and magic - the only weapon that can hold a door open from both sides at once. It is never the strongest in any one thing, and never second in anything that matters.

keyblades.name: Kingdom Key
keyblades.source: the blade that closed the first Door
keyblades.unlock_desc: The starter all-rounder - the benchmark every other blade is measured against.
keyblades.desc: The classic keyblade. Sora's build: even spread, no weakness, endless heart. The safest blade in the game and the most underestimated.

keyblades.name: Way to the Dawn
keyblades.unlock_desc: Beat the Organization echo in Olympus's Underworld games.
keyblades.desc: Riku's tank-brawler build: crushing strength and armor, magic sacrificed. Every hit siphons a thread of life back to the wielder. For those who walk the dark and do not flinch.

keyblades.name: Destiny's Embrace
keyblades.unlock_desc: Beat the Shambler in Beast's Castle - love proves it is not a weakness.
keyblades.desc: The support-mage build. Weak strikes, overwhelming healing and light magic. The blade that refuses to let anyone fall - including the one who wields it.

keyblades.name: Kingdom Key D
keyblades.unlock_desc: Beat the Shambler in Timeless River - light proves it was always watching.
keyblades.desc: The speedster-light build. Quick strikes, fast dodges, clean light. A blade that is already three moves ahead when you have made your first.

keyblades.name: Earthshaker
keyblades.source: the blade of the seeker of power
keyblades.unlock_desc: Beat the Hinge That Opens in the Pride Lands - the first battle won in Twilight Form.
keyblades.desc: The heaviest build in the game: the highest strength and defense, at the cost of speed. Every swing is a mountain falling. The blade of the one who sought power - and paid for it.

keyblades.name: Rainfell
keyblades.unlock_desc: Beat the Organization's Eye in the Land of Dragons - a barrier of light, not of rage.
keyblades.desc: The pure-caster build. Magic outruns every melee, spells chain into spells. A blade that treats every fight like a long-range conversation it intends to win.

keyblades.name: Wayward Wind
keyblades.unlock_desc: Beat Luxord the Gambler at Port Royal - luck is a skill if you force it.
keyblades.desc: The crit-fisher build. Lowest defenses, highest speed and the game's best critical rate. Land enough hits and the wind turns into a storm.

keyblades.name: Bond of Flame
keyblades.source: a chakram thrown through a memory
keyblades.unlock_desc: Beat Saix the Berserker at Disney Castle - burn, and let the burning mean something.
keyblades.desc: The aggression build. Fire-charged combos that never seem to end. For the fighter who would rather end a fight in a minute than survive it for an hour.

keyblades.name: Two Become One
keyblades.source: the Nobody's blade - the mirror of Zero's own
keyblades.unlock_desc: Found beside the red feather in Twilight Town, as if Roxas left it for the only other unremembered.
keyblades.desc: Roxas's blade and Zero's shadow-sibling. The same twilight fusion as the Twilight Keyblade, an inch behind it in every stat - proof that two hearts can be one without losing themselves.

keyblades.name: Ultima Weapon
keyblades.unlock_desc: Synthesized at Halloween Town's second grin - the Heartless' own craft turned against them.
keyblades.desc: The game's highest magic stat. A blade that is almost not a weapon - it is a spell waiting for permission. The ceiling for every magic build.

keyblades.name: Oblivion
keyblades.source: the dark half of Zero's blade
keyblades.unlock_desc: Recovered from Hollow Bastion's reflection - the half of the Keyblade that was always his.
keyblades.desc: A brutal dark-strength blade. Weaker than Way to the Dawn in defense, but hits harder per swing and drinks enemy buffs to do it.

keyblades.name: Oathkeeper
keyblades.source: the light half of Zero's blade
keyblades.unlock_desc: Earned at Hollow Bastion - a promise kept on the machine-heart.
keyblades.desc: A radiant magic blade that shields the wielder as it casts. Weaker in defense than Destiny's Embrace, brighter in burst damage.

keyblades.name: No Name
keyblades.source: the blade that watched a thousand wars
keyblades.unlock_desc: Taken from the Door's shadow at the World That Never Was - an old name, finally given.
keyblades.desc: The tactician build: every drive form drains slower, every dark spell hits harder. A blade that wins fights before they begin.

keyblades.name: Keyblade of People's Hearts
keyblades.source: the blade that never was a heart
keyblades.unlock_desc: Closed inside End of the World's Door - a heart-shaped wound that chose a new purpose.
keyblades.desc: A berserker's dark blade. The lower the HP, the more brutal the strikes - and it feasts on the enemy's drive gauge to do it.

keyblades.name: Kingdom Key (XI)
keyblades.source: a copy that grew a real heart
keyblades.unlock_desc: Found in the Underworld games - the copy that refused to be erased.
keyblades.desc: A perfect copy of the Kingdom Key in every stat - except one ability: it steals the enemy's memory-buffs and keeps them. For the build that wins by unmaking the opponent's plan.

keyblades.name: Ultima Keyseal
keyblades.source: the final keyblade of the final door
keyblades.unlock_desc: Sealed at the end of the World That Never Was - the game's ultimate reward, earned by closing the Door to Darkness.
keyblades.desc: The strongest blade in the game, in every category, everywhere - the reason the final seven levels are worth the walk. There is no build this blade does not make stronger.
